invention_definition.problem: CSF shunt overdrainage in upright posture. Existing solutions (ASD, programmable valves) are binary or require manual adjustment. Need passive, self-regulating drainage that responds to physiological pressure changes without electronics.
invention_definition.buyer: Shunt OEM seeking passive regulation technology (Miethke, Sophysa)

MODELLED.claim: Osmotic gradient of 2-5 mOsm/L sufficient to modulate drainage by 50%
No moving parts — inherent reliability advantage over mechanical valves
